secrets.name: AI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenRouter API key for AI features (grader, analyser, helper). Optional — app boots without it; AI pages show a 'key missing' message. Get one at https://openrouter.ai/keys

secrets.name: AI_API_KEY_2
secrets.description: Second OpenRouter API key for failover. Optional.

secrets.name: AI_API_KEY_3
secrets.description: Third OpenRouter API key for failover. Optional.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key for server-side admin operations (bypasses RLS). Optional — only needed for admin server functions. Find in Supabase dashboard → Settings → API.

secrets.name: PREMIUM_CIPHER_SALT
secrets.description: Salt for premium code cipher. Optional — only needed for premium/admin server functions.
